 ## Session Management
 
-Session files are plain JSON stored in `.github/obo_sessions/`. Use the Read, Write, Glob, and Bash tools directly — no external script is required.
+Prefer the `obo-mcp` MCP tools for `.github/obo_sessions/` state.
+Do not read or write session JSON directly when the MCP tools can perform the operation.
+If `obo-mcp` is unavailable, stop and surface the blocker instead of silently falling back to `obo_helper.py` or ad hoc file edits.
@@
 ### Key Operations
 
 | Operation | How |
 |-----------|-----|
-| List existing sessions | `Glob: .github/obo_sessions/session_*.json`, then Read each |
-| Create new session | Construct JSON object, `Write` to session path |
-| Mark item complete | Read → set `status: "completed"`, `resolution: "…"` → Write |
-| Skip / deny item | Read → set `status: "skipped"`, optional `skip_reason` → Write |
-| Mark item in-progress | Read → set `status: "in_progress"` → Write |
-| Update a field | Read → update field → recalc priority_score if score component → Write |
-| Mark session complete | Read → set `status: "completed"`, `completed_at: <ISO>` → Write |
-| Merge new items | Read → append new items with auto-incremented IDs → Write |
+| List existing sessions | `obo_list_sessions(base_dir, status_filter?)` |
+| Create new session | `obo_create(base_dir, title, description, items=[...])` |
+| Mark item complete | `obo_mark_complete(session_file, item_id, resolution, base_dir?)` |
+| Skip / deny item | `obo_mark_skip(session_file, item_id, base_dir?, reason?)` |
+| Mark item in-progress | `obo_update_field(session_file, item_id, "status", "in_progress", base_dir?)` |
+| Update a field | `obo_update_field(session_file, item_id, field, value, base_dir?)` |
+| Find next item | `obo_next(session_file, base_dir?)` |

 | Operation | How |
 |-----------|-----|
-| List existing sessions | `Glob: .github/obo_sessions/session_*.json`, then Read each |
-| Create new session | Construct JSON object, `Write` to session path |
-| Mark item complete | Read → set `status: "completed"`, `resolution: "…"` → Write |
-| Skip / deny item | Read → set `status: "skipped"`, optional `skip_reason` → Write |
-| Mark item in-progress | Read → set `status: "in_progress"` → Write |
-| Update a field | Read → update field → recalc priority_score if score component → Write |
-| Mark session complete | Read → set `status: "completed"`, `completed_at: <ISO>` → Write |
-| Merge new items | Read → append new items with auto-incremented IDs → Write |
+| List existing sessions | `obo_list_sessions(base_dir, status_filter?)` |
+| Create new session | `obo_create(base_dir, title, description, items=[...])` |
+| Mark item complete | `obo_mark_complete(session_file, item_id, resolution, base_dir?)` |
+| Skip / deny item | `obo_mark_skip(session_file, item_id, base_dir?, reason?)` |
+| Mark item in-progress | `obo_update_field(session_file, item_id, "status", "in_progress", base_dir?)` |
+| Update a field | `obo_update_field(session_file, item_id, field, value, base_dir?)` |
+| Find next item | `obo_next(session_file, base_dir?)` |

What changed:
- Copilot guidance: strengthened the shared rule in `copilot-instructions.md` so it explicitly applies to all supported agents, and updated the source-of-truth note to include Cline.
- Claude Code workflow docs: updated the `/obo`, `/preflight`, and `/validate` sources in `prompts/OneByOne.prompt.md`, `prompts/preflight.prompt.md`, and `prompts/validate.prompt.md` to prefer MCP-backed session handling and to stop surfacing `obo_helper.py` as a fallback.
- Codex skills: updated `skills/one-by-one/SKILL.md` and `skills/one-by-one-codex/SKILL.md` so they now describe MCP-first session operations instead of direct JSON edits or helper-script usage.
- Cline propagation: updated `setup.sh` so generated `.clinerules` explicitly tell Cline to prefer `obo-mcp`, avoid direct session JSON edits, and advertise the current OBO MCP tool set.
- Enforcement: removed the legacy `obo_helper.py` terminal auto-approvals from `settings.json`, so the shared VS Code config no longer nudges agents toward the old path.
- Documentation: added a brief cross-agent note in `README.md` so the expected OBO behavior is visible in repo docs.
